more_info.uses: EU permissions include flavoured drinks, cider and perry, food supplements supplied in a solid form excluding food supplements for infants and  young children’,, food supplements supplied in a liquid form excluding food supplements for infants and young children. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.origin: Extracted with water from Quillaia trees. The extract contains saponins along with sugars and other plant constituents.
more_info.dietary_restrictions: The specified starting material is plant derived and compatible with vegetarian and vegan diets. The specification does not establish halal or kosher certification.
more_info.daily_intake: 3 mg saponins/kg body weight/day from quillaia extract (EFSA, 2019).
more_info.side_effects:
Assessed food-use estimates stayed below the limit.
Animal toxicity associated with the saponin component supported the limit.
more_info.overview: Quillaia extract is classified in food technology as a foaming agent. Its technological role is to help create foam.
